question: Is there a day limit in Pikmin 2?
reply: Listen up, mate! You wanna know if there's a clock ticking on your day in Pikmin 2? Nah, mate, there ain't no limit! You ain't got to worry about a strict time limit. The day just ends when the sun dips below the horizon. You gotta make sure all your Pikmin are either with a captain or back at the Onion before the night creatures roll in, or they'll get eaten! It's all about watching the sun, yeah?
